$comment: Rights ledger template. Copy to <campaign>/07_governance/rights-ledger.json and replace every value. A material is anything you did not write from scratch yourself, plus anything you did: fonts, photos, music, footage, voices, logos, quotes, sample data, third-party marks. Default deny: a material with no row here, or whose row is not state=cleared, may not be published, embedded, or shipped.

columns.id: Stable identifier, prefixed by campaign slug.
columns.material: What it is, specifically enough to find: filename, font family and weight, track title, quoted passage.
columns.origin: Where it came from — commissioned, licensed, public domain, generated by a production tool, made in-house. Say which, not 'internet'.
columns.licence: The licence or permission that actually applies, by name and version, plus the URL or file path of the terms. 'Free' is not a licence.
columns.usageScope: What the licence lets you do here: commercial use, modification, embedding in video, use in paid advertising, trademark-adjacent use. List the ones you rely on.
columns.attributionRequired: Boolean. If true, attributionText must be non-null and must appear in the asset or its caption.
columns.attributionText: The exact credit string required, or null.
columns.disclosure: Any audience-facing note the material obliges you to make, or null. Keep the wording here so every surface uses the same sentence.
columns.state: One of: blocked, cleared, retired. Anything other than cleared means do not publish. New rows start blocked.
columns.block: Why it is blocked, in one sentence, or null once cleared.
columns.clearedBy: Role or initials of whoever cleared it, or null.
columns.appearsIn: Asset ids or file paths that embed this material.
columns.expiresWith: Optional condition that ends the permission — a licence term, a contract, a platform. Null if perpetual.

rules: Default deny. If a material is not listed and cleared, it does not ship.
Licences are recorded by name and version, with the terms archived under sources/ so the claim survives a dead link.
A font licence that covers desktop use does not automatically cover embedding in video or web serving. Record the scope you actually rely on.
Material produced with any generative or synthesis tool gets its own row, with origin naming the tool category and disclosure holding the audience-facing wording.
Retired rows stay in the file, with block explaining what happened, so a removed asset is not quietly reinstated.

materials.material: REPLACE with a specific description of one material.
materials.block: New row; licence terms not yet archived under sources/.
